title: Executive Engineer, 3rd Division, Jaunpur, Purvanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited v. Mahendra Seth
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ disposed without merits findings; consumer to move a fresh clause 6.5 application before the Executive Engineer within three weeks, to be decided within two months, with no coercive action until then.
headnote: The licensee's writ against Permanent Lok Adalat orders was disposed without any opinion on the merits. The consumer was directed to file a fresh application under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the Executive Engineer within three weeks, to be heard and decided within two months if there is no other legal impediment. Coercive action stays until that order.
facts: The Executive Engineer, 3rd Division, Jaunpur, of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitaran Nigam Limited challenged Permanent Lok Adalat, Jaunpur orders of 15 December 2022 and 2 January 2023 in Case No. 33 of 2022, Mahendra Seth versus the Executive Engineer. The licensee said notices under section 22C of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 were issued only on 19 July and 26 September 2022, and pointed to clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as the grievance route. Seth told the Court he was ready to move such an application.

holding_units.topic: Writ disposed by fresh clause 6.5 application to the Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: Without expressing any opinion on the merits, the writ is finally disposed of by directing the consumer to make a fresh application under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 before the Executive Engineer concerned within three weeks, with a certified copy of the order. If the application is made, it may be decided after hearing him within two months, unless another legal impediment exists. Until that final order, no coercive action shall be taken against him.

principle_tags.application: The writ against the Permanent Lok Adalat orders was disposed, without a finding on those orders, by sending the consumer to a fresh application under clause 6.5.

The consumer must apply to the Executive Engineer under clause 6.5 within three weeks; if he does, the Engineer may hear and decide the application within two months, and coercive action is withheld until that order.

not_decided.point: Validity of the Permanent Lok Adalat orders dated 15.12.2022 and 02.01.2023
not_decided.note: The writ was disposed without any opinion on the merits.

not_decided.point: Whether section 22C notices had to issue every day and were bad because they issued only on 19.07.2022 and 26.09.2022
not_decided.note: Raised by the licensee on the Lok Adalat order sheet and left undecided.

not_decided.point: Merits of the consumer's supply grievance
not_decided.note: Left to the fresh clause 6.5 application before the Executive Engineer.
